description: This file contains shell functions for querying and manipulating network interface information in a Linux environment, utilizing ubus calls and jsonfilter for data extraction.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddr
methods.description: Retrieves the first IPv4 address of a specified network interface.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddr6
methods.description: Retrieves the first IPv6 address or prefix of a specified network interface.

methods.name: network_get_subnet
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 subnet (address and mask) of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_subnet6
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv6 subnet of a specified interface, filtering out link-local addresses.

methods.name: network_get_gateway
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 default gateway for a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_gateway6
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv6 default gateway for a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_dnsserver
methods.description: Retrieves DNS servers for a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddrs
methods.description: Retrieves all IPv4 addresses associated with a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddrs6
methods.description: Retrieves all IPv6 addresses associated with a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddrs_all
methods.description: Retrieves all IP addresses (both IPv4 and IPv6) for a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_subnets
methods.description: Retrieves all IPv4 subnets of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_subnets6
methods.description: Retrieves all IPv6 subnets of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_prefixes6
methods.description: Retrieves all IPv6 prefixes of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_prefix_assignments6
methods.description: Retrieves all IPv6 prefix assignments of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_is_up
methods.description: Checks whether a specified network interface is active.

methods.name: network_get_protocol
methods.description: Retrieves the protocol used by a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_uptime
methods.description: Retrieves the uptime of a specified network interface.

methods.name: network_get_metric
methods.description: Retrieves the metric value of a specified network interface.

methods.name: network_get_device
methods.description: Retrieves the layer 3 device associated with a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_physdev
methods.description: Retrieves the layer 2 device associated with a specified interface.

methods.name: network_defer_device
methods.description: Defer network actions for a specified device.

methods.name: network_ready_device
methods.description: Resume network actions for a specified device.

methods.name: network_flush_cache
methods.description: Clears the internal cache to force re-reading network data.
